questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for isolating a span of text for the bidirectional algorithm?
questions.explanation: <bdi> isolates a run of text so the bidirectional algorithm does not mix it with surrounding text.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for overriding text direction explicitly?
questions.explanation: <bdo> overrides directionality and requires a dir attribute ('ltr' or 'rtl').

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for providing a soft line break opportunity?
questions.explanation: <wbr> suggests a possible line break without forcing one.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for associating a human-readable label with a machine-readable value?
questions.explanation: <data> binds a visible label to a machine-readable value via its value attribute.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for representing a date/time with a machine-readable value?
questions.explanation: <time> shows a date/time and can carry a machine-readable value in datetime.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for ruby annotation container for East Asian typography?
questions.explanation: <ruby> wraps base text and annotations (<rt>) and optional fallback parentheses (<rp>).

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for ruby annotation text?
questions.explanation: <rt> provides ruby annotation text.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for fallback parentheses for ruby markup?
questions.explanation: <rp> provides parentheses around ruby annotations in legacy browsers.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for grouping related form controls with an optional caption?
questions.explanation: <fieldset> groups related controls; use <legend> for a caption.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for caption for a fieldset?
questions.explanation: <legend> captions its parent <fieldset>.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for scalar measurement within a known range?
questions.explanation: <meter> displays a measurement (e.g., score, usage) within a defined range.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for task completion progress out of a maximum?
questions.explanation: <progress> displays completion progress with value and max.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for holding inert markup not rendered until activated by script?
questions.explanation: Content inside <template> is inert until cloned into the document.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for slotting light DOM content into a shadow tree?
questions.explanation: <slot> is an insertion point for light DOM in Shadow DOM.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for embedding external resources with parameters?
questions.explanation: <object> embeds external content and can be configured via <param>.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for defining parameters for an embedded object?
questions.explanation: <param> supplies parameters for <object>.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for a dialog box or modal window?
questions.explanation: <dialog> represents a dialog; it shows when the open attribute is present or via script.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for caption for content inside a figure?
questions.explanation: <figcaption> captions content in <figure>.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for providing multiple sources for responsive images?
questions.explanation: <picture> works with <source> to serve responsive images.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for declaring text tracks like captions for media?
questions.explanation: <track> adds timed text tracks to audio/video.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for embedding another page as a nested browsing context?
questions.explanation: <iframe> embeds another HTML page.

questions.text: Which HTML element is appropriate for embedding external content (void element) with minimal DOM integration?
questions.explanation: <embed> is a void element for embedding external content.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for embedding HTML directly in an <iframe> instead of a URL?
questions.explanation: Use srcdoc to provide inline HTML for an iframe.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for restricting capabilities of an <iframe> (e.g., scripts, forms)?
questions.explanation: The sandbox attribute applies restrictions; tokens can relax them.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for controlling which browser features an embedded frame may use?
questions.explanation: The allow attribute applies a Permissions Policy to an iframe.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for verifying that a fetched resource hasn't been tampered with?
questions.explanation: Subresource Integrity uses the integrity attribute on script/link.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for allowing scripts or styles under a Content Security Policy?
questions.explanation: A CSP nonce on script/style allows execution under CSP rules.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for controlling referrer information sent with requests?
questions.explanation: referrerpolicy can restrict or omit the Referer header.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for associating an input with suggestions from a datalist?
questions.explanation: list links an input to a datalist by id.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for overriding a form's submission URL from a submit button?
questions.explanation: formaction overrides the form's action when that control submits.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for overriding a form's HTTP method from a submit control?
questions.explanation: formmethod overrides the form's method for that submission.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for overriding a form's encoding from a submit control?
questions.explanation: formenctype overrides the form's enctype for that control.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for bypassing built-in validation for a particular submit control?
questions.explanation: formnovalidate prevents constraint validation when that control submits.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for specifying a virtual keyboard preference for user agents?
questions.explanation: inputmode hints which on-screen keyboard to show.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for controlling decoding strategy for images?
questions.explanation: decoding can be 'async', 'sync', or 'auto'.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for deferring resource loading until near the viewport?
questions.explanation: loading='lazy' defers image/iframe loading until near viewport.

questions.text: Which attribute is used for declaring that a script is a module?
